title: Products
description: Canonical product registry for the PWB product relationship layer (nutritional supplements). PRD codes are stable internal identifiers used by product-bioactives.json, product-nutrients.json and product-mechanisms.json, mirroring foods.json for the supplement side of recommendations.

claims.description: Provable, factsheet-derived health claims for this product. Not free marketing copy — each entry should trace back to an approved claim or a manufacturer factsheet statement.

servingSize.description: The amount taken in a single administration, e.g. "2 capsules" or "1 sachet (9.83 g)". Paired with servingsPerDay to describe full dosing.

servingsPerContainer.description: How many single-administration servings (per servingSize) the container holds. Replaces the old 'servings' field.

servingsPerDay.description: How many single-administration servings are taken per day. servingsPerContainer / servingsPerDay gives the computed 'lasts X days' figure.

image.description: Path or filename of the product packshot image, supplied by Simon.

cost.description: Retail price for one container, in the site's base currency.

allergens.description: Allergens this product actually contains, using the same 14-slug UK FSA vocabulary as foods.json and SAF006.

dietaryExclusions.description: Dietary preferences (PF020 vocabulary) this product VIOLATES, matching the foods.json convention — e.g. a product containing bovine gelatin lists "vegetarian" and "vegan" here, not the preferences it complies with.
